question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Rendezvous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Rendezvous' refers to a meeting at an agreed time and place. The English meaning is a prearranged meeting place (मिलने की जगह).

 
 
• **​****Example:** We have a rendezvous at the lunch cafe at noon.
 
 
 
• A 'pre-arranged meeting', which is the correct answer, is a meeting set up or planned in advance. Its English meaning is a meeting or appointment set at a predetermined time (पूर्वनिर्धारित सम्मेलन).
 
 
• ​Example: He arrived early for the pre-arranged meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Refusal to meet' refers to the act of not consenting to meet someone (मिलने से इनकार करना).
 
• 'Avoid meeting' refers to the act of intentionally staying away from a meeting (मुलाकात से बचना).
 
• 'Sudden meeting' refers to a meeting that is unexpected and not planned in advance (अचानक मिलन).
